messages.subject: Forge - can you cover the Pennington call Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

I'm double-booked Thursday - any chance you can join the Pennington Industries / Project Forge regulatory update call at 3pm? It's mostly the investigation team but they wanted a contracts view on the supplier indemnities. Should be 30 minutes. I'll send the dial-in if you can make it.

Tom
